title: Locking Dance Choreography Tutorial for Beginners - Online Dance Class at Home

method.teacher_system: Lara introduces the dance style, breaks down individual movements step by step with clear counts, and then guides learners through repetitions with and without music from multiple angles.
method.signature: Mirrors movements clearly and reverses sides for learners, explaining left-right correspondence explicitly.

practices.what: Explains that she will mirror movements so the learner's right side matches her left.
Breaks down the first locking movement step by step starting with arms and counts.
Practices the learned combination a bit faster with counts.
Practices the first part of the choreography with music at a slow tempo.
Turns around to face the back view so learners can follow along without left-right confusion.
Suggests pausing the video to practice with music before moving on to the next section.

adaptations.difficulty: The arm locking movement feels like too much coordination.
adaptations.adjustment: Straighten your arms up and down instead.

beliefs.belief: Locking relies on fast, distinct arm and hand movements combined with relaxed hips and legs.

moments.says: Welcome back on my channel, my name is Lara and I'm your expert for fitness, sports and dance, and I'm super excited to share my first dance tutorial for beginners with you today.
These movements are mostly large and exaggerated, and I will mirror these movements for you, which means my left leg is your right leg.
If it's too much for you, just straighten your arms up and down, it's also all right.
Yes, great! Okay, one more time slowly.
Maybe pause this video, put yourself some music on and practice this first movement.

mentor.what_stays: The teacher leaves the learner feeling encouraged, capable, and ready to groove step-by-step at their own pace.

struggles.theme: The combination feels difficult despite looking easy
Hard to practice without the music track

clicked.theme: Repeating every move made it easy to follow and learn
Clear breakdowns helped complete a school project successfully

requests.theme: Asking for the song title to practice at home
Requests for more beginner tutorials and hip hop classes

meant.theme: Helped pass school PE dance projects and exams
Felt comfortable and made working out at home fun

method.limits: The video only covers the first part of the choreography up to 10 minutes; advanced variations and full speed performance with music beyond the basic tutorial segments are not fully shown in this excerpt.
